subtitle: The Circular Product Builder
intro: I'm the one who builds profitable products that are climate-positive.
body: The best products come from pains you've actually lived. Mine: being a second-hand-first buyer, a zero-waste nerd who keeps running into missing solutions for everyday life. That's why I'm drawn to building products that turn resources nobody wants anymore into something worth paying for.

I've spent my whole professional life building products — first coding and delivering as a software developer, now discovering, prototyping and testing as a Product Manager, proving, every time, that circular doesn't mean less profitable.
